import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Normalize inputs
    if not isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Index)):
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    else:
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Filter order_items to keep only requested products and past sales
    mask_items = order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()

    # If no items, return a zero matrix (with the same columns as the non‑empty case)
    if items.empty:
        # Define a fixed list of feature names (must match the columns created below)
        feature_cols = [
            "num_orders", "num_items", "total_price", "total_freight",
            "mean_price", "max_price", "min_price", "std_price",
            "nunique_seller", "nunique_customer", "mean_freight",
            "mean_review", "review_count", "mean_payment_total",
            "mean_payment_installments", "mean_payment_count",
            "days_since_last", "product_age_days", "sales_per_month",
            "review_rate", "mean_delivery_delay", "has_sales"
        ]
        df = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"), columns=feature_cols)
        return df

    # Merge with orders to obtain customer and delivery info
    orders_sub = orders[["order_id", "customer_id",
                          "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]]
    items = items.merge(orders_sub, how="left", on="order_id")

    # Payment aggregation (per order)
    pay_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        pay_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        pay_total=("payment_value", "sum"),
        pay_install_avg=("payment_installments", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # Review aggregation (per order)
    rev_agg = reviews.groupby("order_id").agg(
        rev_count=("review_score", "count"),
        rev_mean=("review_score", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # Join the aggregates into the items frame
    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Group by product_id for the final features
    grouped = items.groupby("product_id")

    # Build base feature aggregates
    feature_agg = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_orders": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "num_items": grouped["price"].count(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "mean_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "nunique_seller": grouped["seller_id"].nunique(),
        "nunique_customer": grouped["customer_id"].nunique(),
        "mean_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "mean_review": grouped["rev_mean"].mean(),
        "review_count": grouped["rev_count"].sum(),
        "mean_payment_total": grouped["pay_total"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_installments": grouped["pay_install_avg"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_count": grouped["pay_count"].mean(),
        "first_ts": grouped["ts"].min(),
        "last_ts": grouped["ts"].max()
    })

    # Compute time-based features
    feature_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["last_ts"]).dt.days
    feature_agg["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["first_ts"]).dt.days
    # sales per month: avoid division by zero
    age_positive = feature_agg["product_age_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feature_agg["sales_per_month"] = feature_agg["num_orders"] * 30 / age_positive
    # review ratio
    feature_agg["review_rate"] = feature_agg["review_count"] / feature_agg["num_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Compute mean delivery delay (negative = early, positive = late)
    if not items.empty:
        items = items.copy()
        items["delivery_delay"] = (
            items["order_delivered_customer_date"] - items["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).dt.days
        delay_mean = items.groupby("product_id")["delivery_delay"].mean()
    else:
        delay_mean = pd.Series(dtype=float)
    feature_agg = feature_agg.join(delay_mean.rename("mean_delivery_delay"))

    # Flag for products that had sales
    feature_agg["has_sales"] = 1

    # Drop internal columns, fill NaN with 0
    feature_agg = feature_agg.drop(columns=["first_ts", "last_ts"], errors="ignore")
    feature_agg = feature_agg.fillna(0)

    # Keep only numerical columns (default will always be numeric)
    feature_agg = feature_agg.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)
    return feature_agg

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    if not isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Index)):
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Only past sales
    mask_items = order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()

    feature_cols = [
        "num_orders", "num_items", "total_price", "total_freight",
        "mean_price", "max_price", "min_price", "std_price",
        "nunique_seller", "nunique_customer", "mean_freight",
        "mean_review", "review_count", "mean_payment_total",
        "mean_payment_installments", "mean_payment_count",
        "days_since_last", "product_age_days", "sales_per_month",
        "review_rate", "mean_delivery_delay", "has_sales",
        "delivered_ratio", "share_low_reviews", "trend_recent_vs_older",
        "days_since_last_review", "mean_freight_ratio", "orders_last_30d",
        "orders_last_90d", "orders_prev_90d"
    ]

    idx = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
    if items.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=idx, columns=feature_cols)

    # Orders info: delivery dates only for orders already delivered before seed_time
    orders_sub = orders[[
        "order_id", "customer_id",
        "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]].copy()
    orders_sub.loc[orders_sub["order_delivered_customer_date"] >= seed_time,
                   "order_delivered_customer_date"] = pd.NaT

    items = items.merge(orders_sub, how="left", on="order_id")

    # Payments: only payments that already existed before seed_time
    pay_agg = (payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
               .groupby("order_id")
               .agg(pay_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
                    pay_total=("payment_value", "sum"),
                    pay_install_avg=("payment_installments", "mean"))
               .reset_index())

    # Reviews: only reviews created before seed_time
    rev_agg = (reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
               .groupby("order_id")
               .agg(rev_count=("review_score", "count"),
                    rev_mean=("review_score", "mean"))
               .reset_index())

    items = items.merge(pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    items = items.merge(rev_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    grouped = items.groupby("product_id")

    feature_agg = pd.DataFrame({
        "num_orders": grouped["order_id"].nunique(),
        "num_items": grouped["price"].count(),
        "total_price": grouped["price"].sum(),
        "total_freight": grouped["freight_value"].sum(),
        "mean_price": grouped["price"].mean(),
        "max_price": grouped["price"].max(),
        "min_price": grouped["price"].min(),
        "std_price": grouped["price"].std(),
        "nunique_seller": grouped["seller_id"].nunique(),
        "nunique_customer": grouped["customer_id"].nunique(),
        "mean_freight": grouped["freight_value"].mean(),
        "mean_review": grouped["rev_mean"].mean(),
        "review_count": grouped["rev_count"].sum(),
        "mean_payment_total": grouped["pay_total"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_installments": grouped["pay_install_avg"].mean(),
        "mean_payment_count": grouped["pay_count"].mean(),
        "first_ts": grouped["ts"].min(),
        "last_ts": grouped["ts"].max()
    })

    # Delivery delay only for orders delivered before seed_time
    delivered = items[items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()].copy()
    if not delivered.empty:
        delivered["delivery_delay"] = (
            delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
            - delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).dt.days
        delay_mean = delivered.groupby("product_id")["delivery_delay"].mean()
    else:
        delay_mean = pd.Series(dtype=float)
    feature_agg = feature_agg.join(delay_mean.rename("mean_delivery_delay"))

    # Delivered ratio (known only for orders whose estimated date has passed)
    items["delivered_known"] = items["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna().astype(float)
    items["est_passed"] = (items["order_estimated_delivery_date"] < seed_time).astype(float)
    deliv = items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        delivered_known_sum=("delivered_known", "sum"),
        est_passed_sum=("est_passed", "sum"))
    feature_agg["delivered_ratio"] = (deliv["delivered_known_sum"] /
                                      deliv["est_passed_sum"].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0)

    # Review-based ratios
    feature_agg["review_rate"] = feature_agg["review_count"] / feature_agg["num_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    low = items.loc[items["rev_mean"].notna() & (items["rev_mean"] <= 2)] \
               .groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    feature_agg["share_low_reviews"] = (low / feature_agg["num_orders"]).fillna(0)

    # Time dynamics
    feature_agg["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["last_ts"]).dt.days
    feature_agg["product_age_days"] = (seed_time - feature_agg["first_ts"]).dt.days
    age_positive = feature_agg["product_age_days"].clip(lower=1)
    feature_agg["sales_per_month"] = feature_agg["num_orders"] * 30 / age_positive

    # Recent vs older trend
    recent = items[items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)] \
        .groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    older = items[items["ts"] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)] \
        .groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    r30 = items[items["ts"] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)] \
        .groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
    feature_agg["orders_last_30d"] = r30.reindex(feature_agg.index).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["orders_last_90d"] = recent.reindex(feature_agg.index).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["orders_prev_90d"] = older.reindex(feature_agg.index).fillna(0)
    feature_agg["trend_recent_vs_older"] = (
        (feature_agg["orders_last_90d"] + 1) / (feature_agg["orders_prev_90d"] + 1))

    # Last review time
    last_rev = items.loc[items["rev_count"].notna()].groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    feature_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (
        (seed_time - last_rev.reindex(feature_agg.index)).dt.days).fillna(9999)

    # Freight share of price
    feature_agg["mean_freight_ratio"] = (feature_agg["mean_freight"] /
                                         feature_agg["mean_price"].replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0)

    feature_agg["has_sales"] = 1

    feature_agg = feature_agg.drop(columns=["first_ts", "last_ts"], errors="ignore")
    feature_agg = feature_agg.fillna(0)

    feature_agg = feature_agg.reindex(idx)
    feature_agg = feature_agg[feature_cols].fillna(0).astype(float)
    return feature_agg
